0022600133.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers (2-1, 2-0 at home, on a two-game win streak) host the Washington Wizards (2-2, coming off a loss) in the fourth game of Cleveland's season, with the Cavaliers 2nd in the Central, one game back, and 6th in the East, and the Wizards 3rd in the Southeast, one game back, and 9th in the East. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (out, ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve), and Justin Champagnie is day-to-day with a foot injury and is a game-time decision. The teams have not played yet in 2026-27, but Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 130-117 win in Cleveland on April 12, 2026.
